reading.title: A Message Is Not a Delivery
reading.titleZh: 收到提示不等于包裹送达
reading.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创分级模拟
reading.topic: 配送状态、时间窗口与证据边界
reading.passage:
In a fictional campus delivery project, students tested two messages for people expecting parcels. The old message said, "Your parcel has arrived." However, it appeared when a driver scanned a parcel at the local station, not when the parcel reached its owner. Several students left class to collect items that were still on a truck.

The project team changed the first message to explain the actual stage: the parcel had reached the station and was waiting for local delivery. A second message would be sent only after the parcel was placed in a collection locker. It would include the locker number and a collection code.

The team also added an expected delivery window, from two to five in the afternoon. This was a useful estimate, not a promise of arrival at exactly two. If the route changed, the window would be updated, with a short explanation.

During a one-week trial, fewer students made unnecessary trips to the lockers. Yet the team did not claim that transport had become faster. The number of parcels and the distance traveled were similar, and drivers followed the same route. The change mainly helped people understand when to act. Clear information, the students concluded, should name the completed step, explain what comes next, and avoid turning an estimate into a guarantee.
reading.passageZh:
在一个虚构的校园配送项目中，学生们为等待包裹的人测试了两种消息。旧消息写着：“你的包裹已到达。”然而，司机在本地站点扫描包裹时就会出现这条消息，并不是在包裹交到收件人手中时。有几个学生离开课堂去取件，物品却仍然在卡车上。

项目团队修改了第一条消息，说明实际进度：包裹已到达站点，正在等待本地配送。只有在包裹被放进取件柜之后，才会发送第二条消息。第二条消息会包含柜号和取件码。

团队还增加了预计配送时间窗口，即下午两点到五点。这是一个有用的估计，不是承诺恰好两点送达。如果路线发生变化，时间窗口会更新，并附上一段简短说明。

在为期一周的试用中，白跑取件柜的学生减少了。但团队没有宣称运输变快了。包裹数量和运输距离与以前相近，司机走的也是同一条路线。这项改变主要帮助人们理解何时该采取行动。学生们得出结论：清楚的信息应说明已经完成的步骤，解释接下来会发生什么，并避免把估计变成保证。

questions.prompt: When did the old message appear?
questions.promptZh: 旧消息在什么时候出现？
options: When an owner opened the collection locker.
When a driver scanned the parcel at the local station.
When a parcel was first ordered online.
When a driver finished every delivery on the route.
optionsZh: 司机在本地站点扫描包裹时。
首次在网上下单购买包裹中的物品时。
司机完成该路线上的全部配送时。
questions.explanation: 第一段明确区分在local station扫码与包裹到达收件人手中。旧消息在前一个环节就出现，因而造成误解。

questions.prompt: What should happen before the second message is sent?
questions.promptZh: 发送第二条消息之前应该发生什么？
options: Every parcel on the truck must be delivered.
The parcel must be put in a collection locker.
optionsZh: 卡车上的每个包裹都必须送达。
包裹必须被放进取件柜。
questions.explanation: 第二段中的only after限定发送条件：包裹放入取件柜之后才发送第二条消息，并提供柜号与取件码。

questions.prompt: How should people understand the two-to-five delivery window?
questions.promptZh: 人们应该如何理解两点到五点的配送时间窗口？
options: It is an estimate that may be updated if the route changes.
It guarantees that the parcel will arrive at exactly two.
It means collection is forbidden after five.
It proves that all drivers finish work at five.
optionsZh: 它是一个估计，如果路线改变，时间窗口可能更新。
它保证包裹恰好在两点到达。
它表示五点之后禁止取件。
它证明所有司机都在五点下班。
questions.explanation: 第三段明确说这是estimate而非恰好两点到达的promise，并说明路线变化时会更新。文章没有规定取件截止时间或司机下班时间。

questions.prompt: What conclusion is best supported by the trial?
questions.promptZh: 试用结果最能支持哪一项结论？
options: The trucks transported every parcel more quickly.
The number of parcels fell sharply.
Clearer messages helped reduce unnecessary collection trips.
Drivers needed a completely different route.
optionsZh: 卡车运输每个包裹都更快了。
更清楚的消息有助于减少不必要的取件行程。
司机需要一条完全不同的路线。
questions.explanation: 末段观察到白跑取件柜的人减少，但包裹数量、距离和路线没有相应的大变化，因此不能把信息更清楚等同于运输更快。

listening.title: The Bus Connection to the Ferry
listening.titleZh: 前往渡轮码头的接驳巴士
listening.tip: 先盲听判断通知的交通安排，分清巴士与渡轮两个时间。带文精听核对集合地点、票证和行李；选三句各做一组影子跟读，再脱稿用30—60秒复述从集合到登船的流程。音频为浏览器合成朗读，不是真题录音。
listening.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创模拟 · 浏览器合成朗读
listening.passage: This announcement is for students joining Saturday's island visit by ferry. The connecting bus will leave the east campus gate at eight fifteen. Please arrive ten minutes early and show your booking message to the guide. The bus takes about twenty minutes to reach the ferry terminal. Our ferry leaves at nine, so there is time to collect tickets. Keep your small bag with you; larger baggage goes in the lower compartment. Remember to take all your belongings when you get off. At the terminal, wait beside the information desk for the group tickets. Do not join the boarding line until the guide calls your group. If you miss the bus, contact the guide before arranging another journey.
listening.passageZh: 本通知面向参加周六乘渡轮游览岛屿活动的学生。接驳巴士将在八点十五分从校园东门出发。请提前十分钟到达，并向带队人员出示预约消息。巴士大约需要二十分钟到达渡轮码头。我们的渡轮九点出发，所以有时间领取船票。小包请随身携带，较大的行李则放在巴士下部的行李舱内。下车时记得带走所有随身物品。在码头，请在问讯处旁边等待领取团体船票。在带队人员叫到你们这一组之前，不要加入登船队伍。如果你错过了巴士，请先联系带队人员，再安排其他行程。
dictation: The connecting bus will leave the east campus gate at eight fifteen.
Do not join the boarding line until the guide calls your group.

sent.text: The message that appears after a parcel is scanned is useful only if it explains which stage of delivery has been completed.

2026-10-22.title: 周复盘：从看着熟悉到独立解释
2026-10-22.grammarTip: 周复盘不新增课程词，默认40词复习；有到期首次学习自选词时按固定容量安排。先限时独立作答，再检查主句与定语从句的谓语、形容词前be、被动语态和副词。听读区分熟悉感、实际表现与证据范围。原创分级模拟，不是真题。

grammar.prompt: The notes that contain several examples ___ useful during revision.
grammar.promptZh: 包含几个例子的那些笔记在复习时很有用。
grammar.explanation: 主句主语是复数notes，形容词useful前需要are。that contain several examples是修饰notes的定语从句，contain不是主句谓语。

grammar.prompt: Explaining the idea without notes ___ difficult at first.
grammar.promptZh: 起初不看笔记解释这个想法很难。
grammar.explanation: 动名词短语Explaining the idea without notes整体作单数主语。difficult是形容词，不能直接作谓语，前面要用is。

grammar.prompt: The missing details should ___ before the next discussion.
grammar.promptZh: 在下一次讨论之前，遗漏的细节应该被补上。
optionsZh: 补上（过去式或过去分词）
grammar.explanation: details是被补充的内容；情态动词should后接be added，构成情态动词的被动语态。只有added会缺少be。

grammar.prompt: The student explained the connection ___ enough for a partner to follow.

grammar.explanation: 修饰动词explained需要副词clearly；enough放在它修饰的副词之后。clear是形容词。

grammar.prompt: Yesterday, the group ___ both methods before choosing one for the next task.
grammar.promptZh: 昨天，小组先比较了两种方法，再为下一项任务选择一种。
grammar.explanation: Yesterday明确表示已结束的过去时间，应使用一般过去时compared，不能用现在完成时has compared。

grammar.prompt: Which sentence correctly describes a daily learning habit?
grammar.promptZh: 哪句话正确描述了每天的学习习惯？
options: I think one thing I can improve every day.
I thing about one think I can improve every day.
I think about one thing I can improve everyday.
I think about one thing I can improve every day.
optionsZh: 想一个可改进之处，但think后缺少介词about。
把形容词everyday误作时间状语。
我每天思考一件可以改进的事。
grammar.explanation: think about表示思考，thing是名词“事情”；can后用动词原形improve。every day分开写表示“每天”，不是形容词everyday。

reading.title: When Familiar Notes Are Not Enough
reading.titleZh: 当熟悉的笔记还不够时
reading.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创分级模拟
reading.topic: 笔记方法、独立解释与证据范围
reading.passage:
In a campus study workshop, students compared two ways of reviewing notes. For one short section, they copied important sentences and used colors to mark terms. For another, they closed the notebook and wrote a short explanation, then reopened it to check what was missing.

At first, many preferred the colorful pages. The sentences looked familiar, and the pages were easy to read. However, when a partner asked them to explain a connection without looking, some could repeat a term but could not say why it mattered. A familiar page had not always produced an independent explanation.

The second activity often felt less comfortable. Students left gaps, confused two ideas, or discovered that an example was incomplete. Checking these problems gave them a specific reason to return to the material. They added missing connections rather than copying the whole section again.

The tutor warned against turning this small activity into a rule for everyone. The sections were different, and students brought different background knowledge. Their experience did not prove that colorful notes were useless or that one method always worked best.

For the following week, each student chose one difficult topic and planned a short check without notes. The aim was not to make every page look complete, but to find out what could be explained and what still needed attention.
reading.passageZh:
在一次校园学习工作坊中，学生比较了两种复习笔记的方法。对于一个较短的章节，他们抄下重要句子，并用不同颜色标记术语。对于另一个章节，他们合上笔记本，写出简短解释，然后重新打开笔记本检查遗漏之处。

起初，很多人更喜欢彩色页面。这些句子看起来很熟悉，页面也容易阅读。然而，当搭档要求他们不看笔记解释某种联系时，有些人能重复一个术语，却说不出它为何重要。熟悉的页面并不总能带来独立的解释。

第二项活动常让人觉得不太自在。学生留出了空白、混淆了两个想法，或发现某个例子并不完整。检查这些问题让他们有了返回材料的具体理由。他们补充缺失的联系，而不是把整个章节重新抄一遍。

导师提醒大家，不要把这项小活动变成适用于每个人的规则。两个章节不同，学生原有的背景知识也不同。他们的体验不能证明彩色笔记没有用，也不能证明某一种方法永远最好。

在接下来的一周，每名学生选定一个困难主题，计划进行一次不看笔记的简短检查。目标不是让每一页都显得完整，而是弄清楚哪些内容能够解释，哪些仍需关注。

questions.prompt: Why did many students initially prefer the colorful pages?
questions.promptZh: 为什么很多学生起初更喜欢彩色页面？
options: The pages contained no unfamiliar ideas.
The tutor had promised them higher grades.
The sentences looked familiar and were easy to read.
Their partners had already explained every connection.
optionsZh: 页面中没有任何陌生想法。
导师曾承诺给他们更高的分数。
句子看起来熟悉，而且容易阅读。
搭档已经解释了所有联系。
questions.explanation: 第二段直接说明熟悉感和易读性是最初的吸引力。看着熟悉不等于没有陌生想法，也不等于已经能独立解释。

questions.prompt: What did checking the second activity help students do?
questions.promptZh: 检查第二项活动帮助学生做了什么？
options: Locate missing connections and review them specifically.
Avoid returning to the original material.
Copy every sentence into a new notebook.
Prove that their first explanations were always correct.
optionsZh: 定位缺失的联系，并有针对性地复习。
把每句话抄进一本新笔记本。
证明第一次解释总是正确的。
questions.explanation: 第三段指出，发现空白和混淆后，学生有了返回材料的具体理由，补充的是missing connections，而不是重新抄写整个章节。

questions.prompt: Why did the tutor limit the conclusion drawn from the activity?
questions.promptZh: 导师为什么限制了从这项活动中得出的结论？
options: No student had used colors before.
The activity had already tested every possible method.
All students had exactly the same background knowledge.
The sections and students' background knowledge were different.
optionsZh: 没有学生以前用过彩色标记。
活动已经测试了所有可能的方法。
所有学生的背景知识完全相同。
章节和学生的背景知识都不同。
questions.explanation: 第四段给出了两个限制：学习的章节不同，参与者的背景知识不同。因此不能据此断言某种方法对所有人永远最好。

questions.prompt: What was the main purpose of the following week's check?
questions.promptZh: 下一周检查的主要目的是什么？
options: Distinguish what students could explain from what needed more work.
Replace every lesson with copying practice.
Ensure that nobody ever left a gap in an answer.
optionsZh: 让所有笔记本都一样色彩丰富。
区分能解释的内容和仍需继续学习的内容。
用抄写练习替代每节课。
确保任何人的答案都永远没有空白。
questions.explanation: 末段明确把目标从页面看起来完整转向能否解释内容，以及找出仍需关注的部分。空白可以暴露困难，不需要掩盖。

listening.title: Checking Notes Without Looking
listening.titleZh: 不看原文检查笔记掌握情况
listening.tip: 先盲听抓住“合上笔记后独立解释”的活动目的。带文精听区分三分钟阅读与五分钟独立解释，核对先后顺序；选三句各做一组影子跟读，最后用30—60秒脱稿复述检查步骤。浏览器合成朗读，不是真题录音。
listening.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创模拟 · 浏览器合成朗读
listening.passage: This message explains the plan for Thursday's weekly study review session. Please bring one page of notes from a recent lesson. The session begins at four in the usual second floor classroom. First, read your notes for three minutes and then close the page. Write a short explanation of the main idea without looking back. You may leave a space for a detail you cannot remember. After five minutes, compare your explanation with your original notes. Mark any missing connections, not just spelling mistakes or unclear handwriting. Then use a different color to add one example of your own. Keep both versions so you can check them again next week. This practice will not change the grades you have already received.
listening.passageZh: 本消息说明周四每周学习复盘课的安排。请带来最近一节课的一页笔记。课程四点开始，地点是平时使用的二楼教室。首先，阅读笔记三分钟，然后合上这一页。不回看笔记，简要解释主要观点。对于记不起的细节，你可以留出空白。五分钟后，将自己的解释与原始笔记进行比较。标记所有缺失的联系，而不仅仅是拼写错误或不清楚的字迹。然后用另一种颜色补充一个自己的例子。保留两个版本，以便下周再次检查。这项练习不会改变你已经获得的成绩。
dictation: First, read your notes for three minutes and then close the page.
After five minutes, compare your explanation with your original notes.
dictationZh: 首先，阅读笔记三分钟，然后合上这一页。
五分钟后，将自己的解释与原始笔记进行比较。

questions.prompt: What should students do immediately after reading their notes for three minutes?
questions.promptZh: 阅读笔记三分钟后，学生紧接着应该做什么？
options: Copy every sentence in a different color.
Close the page and explain the main idea without looking.
Give their original notes to a teacher for a grade.
Leave the classroom without keeping their work.
optionsZh: 用另一种颜色抄写每句话。
合上笔记，不看原文解释主要观点。
将原始笔记交给老师评分。
不保留作业就离开教室。
questions.explanation: 通知先要求阅读三分钟，再close the page，接着without looking back写出主要观点的简短解释。补充例子和核对笔记发生在后面。

questions.prompt: What should students focus on when comparing the two versions?
questions.promptZh: 比较两个版本时，学生应重点关注什么？
options: Whether both pages use exactly the same color.
Whether the classroom is on a different floor.
Missing connections as well as surface errors.
How to replace the grades they have already received.
optionsZh: 两页是否使用完全相同的颜色。
教室是否换到了另一楼层。
除了表面错误之外，还要关注缺失的联系。
如何替换已经获得的成绩。
questions.explanation: 通知强调Mark any missing connections, not just spelling mistakes or unclear handwriting，即不能只看拼写和字迹。最后也明确原有成绩不变。

sent.text: The students who closed their notebooks discovered gaps that they had not noticed while the familiar sentences were in front of them.
sent.main: The students discovered gaps.
sent.mainZh: 学生发现了遗漏。
sent.translation: 那些合上笔记本的学生发现了遗漏，而这些遗漏是熟悉的句子摆在面前时他们没有注意到的。
sent.structure: 主句The students discovered gaps；who closed their notebooks修饰students。that they had not noticed修饰gaps；while the familiar sentences were in front of them说明过去未注意到遗漏时的情境。
grammar: closed属于修饰students的定语从句，discovered才是主句谓语。
had not noticed表示先于discovered的过去情况；while从句的谓语是were，句中各分句都有自己的限定谓语。
sent.examTip: 先括起who和that引导的两个定语从句，再用“谁—发现—什么”找出主干，不要把closed误当主句谓语。
sent.topic: 两个定语从句、主句谓语与时间关系

trans.source: 看起来很熟悉的笔记，不一定能帮助你独立解释一个想法。
trans.answer: Notes that look familiar do not necessarily help you explain an idea independently.
trans.alternative: Familiar notes do not always help you explain an idea on your own.
acceptedAnswers: Notes that look familiar do not necessarily help you explain an idea independently.
Familiar notes do not always help you explain an idea on your own.
trans.grammar: that look familiar修饰复数notes；主句谓语为do not necessarily help。“不一定”不是完全否定，用not necessarily或not always。independently是副词，也可用on your own。
trans.topic: 定语从句、部分否定与副词

trans.source: 如果你发现某个联系遗漏了，就应当在下次讨论前把它补上。
trans.answer: If you find that a connection is missing, you should add it before the next discussion.
trans.alternative: If you notice a missing connection, you should add it before the next discussion.
acceptedAnswers: If you find that a connection is missing, you should add it before the next discussion.
If you notice a missing connection, you should add it before the next discussion.
trans.grammar: if从句用一般现在时find；that a connection is missing中，missing表示缺失状态，前面需要is。should后接动词原形add，it指前面的connection。
trans.topic: 条件句、形容词前be与指代

2026-10-23.title: 媒体与照片：图片的日期也是信息
2026-10-23.grammarTip: 四级专项衔接：阅读区分照片真实与照片能否证明当前情况，核对拍摄日期、地点及说明；听力辨认投稿截止时间与说明更正步骤。继续巩固主句和定语从句的谓语、形容词前的be、被动语态、副词与every day/everyday。材料为原创分级模拟，不是实时新闻或真题。

words.exampleZh: 当地报纸在照片下方刊登了一则更正。

words.exampleZh: 这本月刊设有一个有关校园生活的专栏。

words.example: The journalist checked the date before using the picture.
words.exampleZh: 记者在使用图片前核查了日期。

words.example: The publisher asked the author to check the final text.
words.exampleZh: 出版社请作者检查最终文本。

words.example: The date of publication was later than the date of the interview.
words.exampleZh: 发表日期晚于采访日期。

words.example: The radio station will broadcast the interview tomorrow.

words.example: The museum invited the press to view its new collection.

words.meaning: 媒体；大众传播媒介（medium的复数形式）
words.example: Check the source before sharing a photograph on social media.

words.example: The reporter asked who had taken the original photograph.

words.example: Her weekly column answers readers' questions about science.

words.example: You can subscribe to the magazine through its website.
words.exampleZh: 你可以通过该杂志的网站订阅。

words.example: An annual subscription gives readers access to twelve issues.

additionalWords.example: The photograph shows the bridge before the repair work ended.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 这张照片展示了修缮工程结束之前的桥。

additionalWords.example: The photography club teaches students to write accurate captions.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 摄影社团教学生撰写准确的图片说明。

additionalWords.example: Check the date setting on your camera before the trip.

additionalWords.example: If you quote a speaker, keep the original meaning clear.

additionalWords.example: A rumor is not reliable evidence that an event has happened.

additionalWords.exampleZh: 图片说明提供了照片的拍摄日期、地点和来源。

grammar.prompt: The photograph that shows workers on the bridge ___ several years old.
grammar.promptZh: 那张展示桥上工人的照片已有好几年历史。
grammar.explanation: 主句是The photograph is several years old。that shows workers on the bridge是定语从句，shows不是主句谓语；主语photograph为单数，因此用is。

grammar.prompt: The dates printed below the two pictures ___ different.
grammar.promptZh: 印在这两张图片下方的日期不同。
grammar.explanation: different是形容词，需要系动词be。主语是复数dates，printed below the two pictures是修饰dates的过去分词短语，不能代替主句的are。

grammar.prompt: The source of every photograph should ___ before publication.
grammar.promptZh: 每张照片的来源都应在发表前被核查。
optionsZh: 核查（过去式或过去分词）
grammar.explanation: source是被核查的对象，因此用被动语态。情态动词should后使用be加过去分词checked，组成should be checked。

grammar.prompt: The revised caption explains the location more ___ than the first one.
grammar.promptZh: 修改后的图片说明比第一版更准确地解释了地点。
grammar.explanation: 修饰动词explains需要副词accurately；more accurately表示更准确地。accurate和inaccurate是形容词，accuracy是名词。

grammar.prompt: The reporter checks messages ___ and writes about ___ life on campus.
grammar.promptZh: 这名记者每天查看消息，并报道校园日常生活。
grammar.explanation: 第一空说明查看消息的频率，用分开的every day，意为每天；第二空修饰名词life，用形容词everyday，意为日常的。

grammar.prompt: The photographer who ___ the original file can explain its background.
grammar.promptZh: 保留了原始文件的摄影师能够解释照片的背景。
grammar.explanation: 主句谓语是can explain；who引导的定语从句也需要谓语。who指单数photographer，因此用keeps。不能因为主句已有谓语就省略从句谓语。

reading.title: An Old Photograph in a New Story
reading.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创分级模拟
reading.topic: 照片语境、时间与图片说明
reading.passage:
In a fictional college newsroom, an editor chose a striking photograph for a story about a riverside bridge. Workers stood behind a fence, and part of the road was closed. The picture was sharp and genuine, so she believed it was suitable for publication.

Before the page appeared, a student reporter checked the original file. The photograph had been taken three years earlier, during a repair project. The fence had since been removed, and the new story concerned a walking route beside the bridge. Without a date, readers might assume that the road was still closed.

The editor considered deleting the photograph. The reporter suggested another option: use it in a small section about the bridge's history, with a caption stating the date, place, and reason for the closure. For the main story, they could request a recent picture of the walking route.

The team then added a question to its checklist: Does this image show the situation described in this part of the article? Checking whether a picture is real is important, but it is not the same as checking whether it fits the story. An older photograph can remain valuable when its background is clear. The problem begins when readers are encouraged to treat a past scene as evidence of a present condition.
reading.passageZh:
在一个虚构的大学新闻编辑室里，一名编辑为一篇有关河边桥梁的报道选了一张引人注目的照片。工人们站在围栏后面，一部分道路处于封闭状态。图片清晰而且真实，因此她认为适合发表。

在页面发布之前，一名学生记者检查了原始文件。这张照片拍摄于三年前的一次修缮工程期间。后来围栏已经拆除，而新报道讨论的是桥边的一条步行路线。如果不注明日期，读者可能会以为道路仍然封闭。

编辑考虑删掉这张照片。记者提出了另一种选择：把它用于一个介绍桥梁历史的小栏目，配上说明拍摄日期、地点和封路原因的图片说明。对于主要报道，他们可以请求提供一张步行路线的近期照片。

随后，团队在检查清单中增加了一个问题：这张图片展示的是否就是文章这一部分所描述的情况？核查图片是否真实很重要，但这与核查图片是否符合报道语境并不是一回事。当背景交代清楚时，一张旧照片仍然可以很有价值。问题始于读者被引导把过去的场景当作当前状况的证据。

questions.prompt: Why did the editor first consider the photograph suitable?
questions.promptZh: 编辑最初为什么认为这张照片适合使用？
options: It had been taken that morning.
It was clear and showed a real scene.
It included a map of the new walking route.
It showed that all repair work was finished.
optionsZh: 它清晰且展示了真实场景。
它包含了新步行路线的地图。
它表明所有修缮工作都已完成。
questions.explanation: 第一段中的sharp and genuine说明编辑关注的是清晰度和真实性，但她当时还没有核对照片的时间是否符合新报道。

questions.prompt: What might readers wrongly believe if the date were missing?
questions.promptZh: 如果缺少日期，读者可能产生什么误解？
options: The bridge was being built for the first time.
The walking route did not belong to the college.
The reporter had taken the photograph herself.
The road near the bridge was still closed.
optionsZh: 步行路线不属于这所大学。
这张照片是记者本人拍摄的。
桥附近的道路仍然封闭。
questions.explanation: 第二段明确指出，没有日期会让读者以为道路仍然封闭；实际上照片拍于三年前，围栏后来已经拆除。

questions.prompt: How did the reporter suggest using the older photograph?
questions.promptZh: 记者建议如何使用这张旧照片？
options: Place it in a history section with an informative caption.
Use it as the main image without any changes.
Remove the fence from the picture digitally.
Change its date to match the publication date.
optionsZh: 把它放在历史栏目中，并配上提供必要信息的说明。
不作任何调整，直接将它用作主图。
用数字编辑方式去掉图片中的围栏。
把拍摄日期改成发表日期。
questions.explanation: 第三段建议保留其历史价值，并标明日期、地点与封路原因；主要报道另找近期照片。文中没有建议修改画面或伪造日期。

questions.prompt: What is the main lesson of the passage?
questions.promptZh: 本文的主要启示是什么？
options: Older photographs should never appear in new publications.
A sharp photograph always explains a current event correctly.
A genuine photograph still needs context to fit a story.
A publication date tells readers when every photograph was taken.
optionsZh: 旧照片永远不应出现在新出版物中。
一张清晰的照片总能正确解释当前事件。
真实照片仍需要语境信息，才能恰当地用于报道。
发表日期能告诉读者每张照片的拍摄时间。
questions.explanation: 末段区分了真实性与语境适配。旧照片并非不能用，但不能让读者误把过去场景当作当前证据；发表时间也不等于拍摄时间。

listening.title: Correcting a Photo Exhibition Caption
listening.titleZh: 更正摄影展的图片说明
listening.tip: 先盲听确定这是投稿与更正说明，记录截止时间和提交方式。带文精听核对日期、地点、作者与更正编号；选三句各做一组影子跟读，再用30—60秒脱稿复述投稿后发现说明错误应如何处理。音频为浏览器合成朗读，不是真题录音。
listening.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创模拟 · 浏览器合成朗读
listening.passage: Here is a reminder for students entering the campus photography exhibition. Upload your original photograph through the club website by four on Friday. Printed copies are not required at this stage. Each picture needs a caption giving the date, location, and photographer's name. If you discover an error after submitting, open the correction form. Enter your submission number and write the corrected caption in full. Please do not upload the same photograph again as a new entry. A volunteer will check the change and send you a confirmation message. This message confirms the correction, not acceptance into the exhibition. The final selection will be posted on Monday afternoon. Contact the club office if you cannot find your submission number.
listening.passageZh: 这里提醒准备参加校园摄影展的学生：请在周五四点前通过社团网站上传原始照片。现阶段不要求提交打印件。每张照片都需要一段图片说明，注明拍摄日期、地点和摄影者姓名。如果提交后发现错误，请打开更正表格。输入你的投稿编号，并完整写出更正后的说明。请不要把同一张照片再次作为新作品上传。一名志愿者将核查修改，并向你发送确认消息。这条消息确认的是说明已更正，并不表示作品已入选展览。最终入选名单将在周一下午发布。如果找不到投稿编号，请联系社团办公室。
dictation: Printed copies are not required at this stage.
This message confirms the correction, not acceptance into the exhibition.
dictationZh: 现阶段不要求提交打印件。
这条消息确认的是说明已更正，并不表示作品已入选展览。

questions.prompt: What should students submit by four on Friday?
questions.promptZh: 学生应该在周五四点前提交什么？
options: A printed copy at the club office.
A final selection list on the website.
An original photograph through the club website.
A new photograph every time a caption changes.
optionsZh: 向社团办公室提交打印件。
在网站上提交最终入选名单。
通过社团网站提交原始照片。
每次修改说明都提交一张新照片。
questions.explanation: 通知要求在周五四点前通过club website上传original photograph，并明确说现阶段不需要打印件。周一下午发布的是最终入选名单。

questions.prompt: What does the message sent after a caption change confirm?
questions.promptZh: 修改图片说明后发送的消息确认了什么？
options: The correction has been checked, but the work is not necessarily selected.
The photograph is definitely accepted into the exhibition.
The original photograph must be uploaded again.
The exhibition has been moved to Friday.
optionsZh: 更正已经核查，但作品不一定入选。
照片已经确定入选展览。
必须再次上传原始照片。
questions.explanation: 重点听not acceptance：志愿者核查更正后发确认消息，只说明更正已处理，不代表入选。入选结果要等周一下午的最终名单。

sent.text: A photograph that was taken during an earlier repair project can mislead readers if its caption does not explain when the scene was recorded.
sent.main: A photograph can mislead readers if its caption does not explain when the scene was recorded.
sent.mainZh: 如果图片说明没有解释场景记录于何时，一张照片就可能误导读者。
sent.translation: 一张在较早的一次修缮工程期间拍摄的照片，如果图片说明没有解释场景记录于何时，就可能误导读者。
sent.structure: 主句为A photograph can mislead readers；that was taken during an earlier repair project是修饰photograph的定语从句；if引导条件状语从句；when the scene was recorded是explain的宾语从句。
grammar: was taken属于定语从句，主句仍需要can mislead。定语从句中的that指代被拍摄的photograph，因此使用被动语态。
when the scene was recorded是宾语从句，使用陈述语序the scene was recorded，不能改成疑问语序was the scene recorded。
sent.examTip: 先识别photograph—can mislead—readers这一主干，再补充拍摄背景和if条件；不要把定语从句中的was taken当成全句唯一谓语。
sent.topic: 主句与定语从句、条件从句和宾语从句

trans.source: 一张没有注明拍摄日期的旧照片可能会让读者误解当前情况。
trans.answer: An old photograph without the date it was taken may cause readers to misunderstand the current situation.
trans.alternative: An older photograph that does not show when it was taken may lead readers to misunderstand the present situation.
acceptedAnswers: An old photograph without the date it was taken may cause readers to misunderstand the current situation.
An older photograph that does not show when it was taken may lead readers to misunderstand the present situation.
trans.grammar: 主语是An old photograph，谓语是may cause；without短语补充缺少日期这一条件。cause somebody to do或lead somebody to do表示使某人做某事；was taken表示照片被拍摄。
chunks: an old photograph without the date it was taken
trans.topic: 照片语境、被动语态与动词搭配

trans.source: 在发表照片之前，记者应该核查来源，并清楚地说明拍摄地点。
trans.answer: Before publishing a photograph, the reporter should check its source and clearly state where it was taken.
trans.alternative: Before the photograph is published, the reporter should check its source and clearly explain where it was taken.
acceptedAnswers: Before publishing a photograph, the reporter should check its source and clearly state where it was taken.
Before the photograph is published, the reporter should check its source and clearly explain where it was taken.
trans.grammar: before后可以接动名词publishing，逻辑主语与主句reporter一致；也可使用before引导的被动从句。should后并列使用check和state；clearly修饰说明的动作，where从句使用陈述语序。
chunks: clearly state where it was taken

2026-10-24.title: 天气与观察：让比较发生在相同条件下
2026-10-24.grammarTip: 四级专项衔接：阅读识别测量地点、时间与结论的范围；听力抓住活动转移的条件和最终集合通知。继续区分主句与定语从句谓语，检查形容词前的be、被动语态和词形。材料为原创分级模拟，校园与事件均为虚构，不是实时天气预报或真题。

words.example: A change in the weather may affect our outdoor activity.
words.exampleZh: 天气变化可能影响我们的户外活动。

words.example: The atmosphere contains gases that surround the earth.
words.exampleZh: 大气包含环绕地球的气体。

words.example: The chart compares annual rainfall in two regions.
words.exampleZh: 图表比较了两个地区的年降雨量。

words.example: A sudden storm forced the team to move indoors.
words.exampleZh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨迫使团队转移到室内。

words.example: We heard thunder before the rain reached the campus.
words.exampleZh: 雨到达校园之前，我们听到了雷声。

words.example: A flash of lightning appeared above the distant hills.
words.exampleZh: 远处的山丘上方出现了一道闪电。

words.example: A gentle breeze moved the leaves outside the window.
words.exampleZh: 一阵微风吹动了窗外的树叶。

words.example: The afternoon was cloudy, but no rain was recorded.
words.exampleZh: 下午多云，但没有记录到降雨。

words.example: The bench near the entrance was in bright sunshine.
words.exampleZh: 入口附近的长椅处在明亮的阳光下。

words.example: A thin layer of frost covered the grass in the morning.
words.exampleZh: 早晨，草地上覆盖着一层薄霜。

words.example: Water in the shallow container may freeze overnight.
words.exampleZh: 浅容器中的水可能在夜间结冰。

words.example: The ice began to melt as the morning grew warmer.
words.exampleZh: 随着早晨逐渐变暖，冰开始融化。

additionalWords.example: The forecast suggests that rain may arrive in the afternoon.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 天气预报显示，下午可能会下雨。

additionalWords.example: High humidity can make the air feel uncomfortable.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 高湿度会使空气让人感觉不舒服。

additionalWords.example: The room became hot and humid after the windows were closed.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 窗户关上后，房间变得又热又潮湿。

additionalWords.meaning: 温和的；不严寒的；轻微的
additionalWords.example: A mild winter does not mean that every day will be warm.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 温和的冬季并不意味着每一天都暖和。

additionalWords.example: The outdoor event was canceled because of severe weather.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 由于恶劣天气，户外活动被取消了。

additionalWords.example: The book describes plants that grow in tropical forests.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 这本书描述了生长在热带森林中的植物。

additionalWords.example: The class compared the polar regions with warmer areas.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 课堂上比较了极地地区与较温暖的地区。

additionalWords.example: The research ship crossed the ocean to collect information.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 这艘科考船横渡海洋去收集信息。

additionalWords.example: A small island appeared on the map near the coast.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 地图上靠近海岸的位置有一座小岛。

additionalWords.example: Weather conditions vary greatly across the continent.
additionalWords.exampleZh: 整个大陆各地的天气状况差异很大。

grammar.prompt: The student who records the temperature every morning ___ responsible for the chart.
grammar.promptZh: 那名每天早晨记录温度的学生负责这张图表。
grammar.explanation: 主句是The student is responsible for the chart。who records the temperature every morning是定语从句，records不能替代主句谓语；单数student后用is，构成be responsible for。

grammar.prompt: The readings taken at different times ___ not directly comparable.
grammar.promptZh: 在不同时间取得的读数不能直接比较。
grammar.explanation: comparable是形容词，需要be。主语readings是复数，用are；taken at different times是修饰readings的过去分词短语，不是主句谓语。

grammar.prompt: The location of each instrument must ___ in the notebook.
grammar.promptZh: 每台仪器的位置都必须记录在笔记本中。
optionsZh: 记录（过去式或过去分词）
grammar.explanation: location是被记录的对象，因此用被动语态。must后接be recorded，不能省略be或使用主动形式record。

grammar.prompt: The group compared the two sets of results ___.
grammar.promptZh: 小组仔细地比较了两组结果。
grammar.explanation: 这里修饰动词compared，需要副词carefully。careful和careless是形容词，care是名词或动词，不能在此承担方式状语。

grammar.prompt: The air felt very ___ after the rain.
grammar.promptZh: 雨后空气感觉很潮湿。
grammar.explanation: felt在这里是系动词，后接形容词humid描述air的状态。humidity是湿度这一名词，humidify是使湿润的动词。

grammar.prompt: The instruments that ___ near the wall give higher readings at noon.
grammar.promptZh: 位于墙边的仪器在中午给出的读数更高。
grammar.explanation: 主句谓语是give。that引导的定语从句也需要谓语，that指代复数instruments，因而用stand，不用单数stands或非谓语形式。

reading.title: Two Readings, Two Different Conditions
reading.titleZh: 两个读数，两种不同条件
reading.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创分级模拟
reading.topic: 温度观察、比较条件与结论范围
reading.passage:
At a fictional college, a weather club compared temperatures near a brick wall and beside a lawn. The wall reading was higher, and one member proposed a striking headline: the whole city was becoming hotter. Another member asked when the readings had been taken.

The lawn measurement came from nine in the morning, while the wall measurement came from noon. The instruments had also been placed at different heights. With several conditions changing together, the group could not tell how much of the difference was related to location.

They redesigned their observation. Two matching instruments were placed at the same height, with similar protection from direct sunshine. Students recorded both readings at the same times for five days. They also noted cloud cover and whether the ground was wet. The wall location remained warmer on some afternoons, but the difference was smaller on cloudy days.

In their report, the students described the places and hours they had observed. They did not claim that two campus locations represented every neighborhood. They also avoided describing five days of measurements as a long history of changing weather.

The final chart looked less dramatic than the first headline. However, a reader could now see what had been compared and what remained unknown. The club kept the earlier notes to explain why its first comparison had been unfair.
reading.passageZh:
在一所虚构的大学，天气社团比较了砖墙附近与草坪旁的温度。墙边的读数更高，一位成员提出了一个醒目的标题：整座城市正在变热。另一位成员问，这些读数是什么时候取得的。

草坪旁的测量是在早晨九点进行的，而墙边的测量是在中午进行的。仪器还被放在不同高度。多个条件同时发生变化，因此小组无法判断差异中有多少与位置有关。

他们重新设计了观察方法。两台相同型号的仪器被放在同样高度，并采取相似的遮挡措施，避免阳光直射。学生连续五天在相同的时刻记录两处读数。他们还记下了云量以及地面是否潮湿。墙边在某些下午仍然更暖，但阴天时差异较小。

在报告中，学生描述了他们观察的地点和时段。他们没有声称校园中的两处位置能代表每个社区，也没有把五天的测量描述成长期的天气变化记录。

最终图表不如最初的标题引人注目。然而，读者现在能够看清比较了什么，以及哪些方面仍不清楚。社团保留了先前的笔记，用来解释第一次比较为什么不公平。

questions.prompt: What was one problem with the club's first comparison?
questions.promptZh: 社团第一次比较存在什么问题？
options: Both instruments were used inside a classroom.
The readings were taken at different times of day.
The lawn temperature was never recorded.
optionsZh: 两台仪器都在教室内使用。
读数是在一天中的不同时刻取得的。
questions.explanation: 第二段指出草坪读数来自早晨九点，墙边读数来自中午，仪器高度也不同。时间与位置等条件同时变化，不能把全部差异归因于位置。

questions.prompt: How did the students improve their observation?
questions.promptZh: 学生如何改进观察方法？
options: They removed all notes about cloudy weather.
They chose only the highest reading each day.
They used matching instruments at the same height and times.
They replaced the measurements with a newspaper headline.
optionsZh: 他们删除了所有关于多云天气的笔记。
他们每天只选取最高读数。
他们使用同型号仪器，在相同高度和时刻测量。
他们用报纸标题代替了测量。
questions.explanation: 第三段列出了匹配仪器、相同高度、类似遮挡和相同观测时间这些改进，并继续记录云量与地面状况，而不是删去天气信息。

questions.prompt: Why did the report avoid a conclusion about the whole city?
questions.promptZh: 报告为什么没有对整座城市作出结论？
options: Two campus locations were not enough to represent every neighborhood.
The students knew that all neighborhoods had identical temperatures.
No one was allowed to compare temperatures on campus.
The instruments could only show cloud cover.
optionsZh: 校园中两个位置不足以代表每个社区。
学生知道所有社区的温度完全相同。
校园里不允许任何人比较温度。
questions.explanation: 第四段明确限制了结论的适用范围：两处校园位置不能代表所有社区，五天也不能代表长期变化。没有证据不等于各处完全相同。

questions.prompt: What is the main benefit of the final report?
questions.promptZh: 最终报告的主要优点是什么？
options: It proves that dramatic headlines are always false.
It predicts the weather for the whole next year.
It hides the mistakes in the first observation.
It makes the comparison and its limits clear.
optionsZh: 它证明醒目的标题总是错误的。
它预测了下一整年的天气。
它隐藏了最初观察中的错误。
它清楚说明了比较方法及其局限。
questions.explanation: 末段强调读者能看清比较了什么、仍有哪些未知；保留原笔记也让最初的问题可追溯。文章没有给出全年预报，也没有一概否定醒目标题。

listening.title: A Weather Backup for Saturday's Activity
listening.titleZh: 周六活动的天气备用安排
listening.tip: 盲听先确定活动是否取消，再记转移条件、集合时间和地点。带文精听核对if、by nine和ten；选三句分别进行一组影子跟读，再用30—60秒说明室外与室内两种安排。浏览器合成朗读不是实时天气预报，也不是真题录音。
listening.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创模拟 · 浏览器合成朗读
listening.passage: Here is an update about Saturday's outdoor activity for the campus nature club. The current forecast suggests rain, but we have not canceled the event. If heavy rain is expected, we will use the science building instead. Please check the club notice by nine on Saturday morning. It will confirm the final location before you leave your room. If we move indoors, meet at the science building entrance at ten. Otherwise, meet at the garden gate at the same time. Bring your notebook, but leave the outdoor equipment at home if necessary. Indoor groups will examine photographs and discuss their observations from last week. Do not go to the garden first when the notice says indoors.
listening.passageZh: 这里更新校园自然社团周六户外活动的安排。目前的天气预报显示可能有雨，但我们尚未取消活动。如果预计会有大雨，我们将改用科学楼。请在周六早晨九点前查看社团通知。通知会在你离开房间之前确认最终地点。如果活动转到室内，请十点在科学楼入口集合。否则，请在相同时间到花园大门集合。带上笔记本，但必要时请把户外器材留在住处。室内小组将查看照片，并讨论上周的观察情况。当通知说明在室内举行时，不要先去花园。
dictation: Please check the club notice by nine on Saturday morning.
If we move indoors, meet at the science building entrance at ten.
dictationZh: 请在周六早晨九点前查看社团通知。
如果活动转到室内，请十点在科学楼入口集合。

questions.prompt: What should students do by nine on Saturday morning?
questions.promptZh: 学生应该在周六早晨九点前做什么？
options: Collect outdoor equipment at the science building.
Check the club notice for the final location.
Cancel their membership in the nature club.
optionsZh: 在科学楼领取户外器材。
查看社团通知，确认最终地点。
取消自然社团的会员资格。
questions.explanation: 九点前是查看通知的时间，集合时间是十点。通知将确认最终地点；当前预报可能有雨不等于活动已经取消。

questions.prompt: Where should students meet if the activity moves indoors?
questions.promptZh: 如果活动转到室内，学生应该在哪里集合？
options: At the science building entrance at ten.
At the garden gate at nine.
At the garden first and then at the science building.
questions.explanation: 通知给出的室内方案是十点到科学楼入口。最后一句特别说明，通知写明室内时不要先去花园；花园大门是室外方案的集合点。

sent.text: The readings that students collect at the same time are easier to compare because fewer conditions change between the two observations.
sent.main: The readings are easier to compare because fewer conditions change between the two observations.
sent.mainZh: 这些读数更容易比较，因为两次观察之间变化的条件更少。
sent.translation: 学生在同一时刻采集的读数更容易比较，因为两次观察之间变化的条件更少。
sent.structure: 主句是The readings are easier to compare；that students collect at the same time是修饰readings的定语从句，that在从句中作collect的宾语；because引导原因状语从句，主语是fewer conditions，谓语是change。
grammar: collect属于定语从句，不能代替主句中的are。easier是形容词比较级，前面保留系动词are，与复数readings一致。
fewer修饰可数名词复数conditions；because后接完整从句，不能只保留一个名词短语。
sent.examTip: 先找readings—are—easier to compare，再将定语从句放回去，最后读取because后面的原因；不要见到collect就认为主句已有谓语。
sent.topic: 主句与定语从句、形容词前be和原因从句

trans.source: 为了公平地比较两个地点，学生应该在相同的时间记录温度。
trans.answer: To compare the two locations fairly, students should record the temperature at the same time.
trans.alternative: Students should record temperatures at the same time to make a fair comparison between the two locations.

reading.title: Practice the Difficult Part, Then Reconnect the Whole
reading.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创分级模拟
reading.topic: 局部练习与完整演奏的不同作用
reading.passage:
At a fictional college, a student music group began every rehearsal by playing its concert piece from the first note. The opening became smooth, but the same difficult passage near the end still caused trouble. When someone made a mistake, the group often returned to the beginning.

Their leader recorded one rehearsal and noticed an imbalance. The students spent most of their time on music they could already play. The difficult passage received only a few hurried attempts, usually when everyone was tired. Playing the piece again felt productive because the group was busy, but activity was not the same as improvement.

For the next rehearsal, the leader changed the order. First, the players identified the exact point where their rhythm separated. They practiced a short section slowly, listened to one another, and gradually increased the speed. They then added the sections immediately before and after it.

Finally, they played the complete piece without stopping. This revealed a new problem: a successful local repair did not automatically produce a smooth transition. Full performances helped them connect sections and manage their energy, while focused practice helped them correct specific weaknesses.

The group kept both methods. Its new rule was not to avoid starting at the beginning, but to know why a complete performance was useful at that moment. A practice plan should respond to the problem, rather than simply repeat a familiar routine.
reading.passageZh:
在一所虚构的大学，一个学生音乐小组每次排练都从第一个音开始演奏音乐会曲目。开头变得很流畅，但接近结尾的同一个难点片段仍然出问题。有人出错时，小组常常又回到开头。

领队录下了一次排练，发现了时间分配不均的问题。学生们把大部分时间花在已经会演奏的部分上。难点片段只得到了几次匆忙的尝试，而且通常是在大家疲惫的时候。再次演奏整首曲子让人感觉有效率，因为小组一直在忙碌，但忙碌不等于进步。

下一次排练时，领队改变了顺序。首先，演奏者找出节奏不一致的具体位置。他们慢速练习一个短片段，互相聆听，并逐渐加快速度。然后，他们加入了紧邻这个片段前后的部分。

最后，他们不停顿地演奏了整首曲子。这暴露了一个新问题：局部问题解决了，并不会自动带来流畅的过渡。完整演奏帮助他们连接各部分并分配精力，而集中练习帮助他们纠正具体的薄弱环节。

小组保留了这两种方法。新规则不是避免从开头演奏，而是清楚当下为什么需要一次完整演奏。练习计划应该针对问题，而不是简单重复熟悉的惯例。

questions.promptZh: 最初，为什么那个难点片段一直没有得到解决？

questions.explanation: 第四段的not automatically produce a smooth transition说明局部改进不等于整体衔接自然。完整演奏与局部练习解决的问题不同，二者互补。

optionsZh: 永远不要从第一个音开始演奏。
一直重复最简单的部分，直到它完美。
根据需要解决的问题选择练习方法。
只凭完整演奏的次数判断进步。
questions.explanation: 末段强调计划要回应具体问题，而不是机械重复熟悉的惯例。小组没有否定完整演奏，而是同时保留两种方法，并明确各自用途。

grammar.prompt: All donated blankets must ___ before they are placed on the tables.

grammar.prompt: The volunteer who ___ the registration forms can answer your question.

grammar.prompt: The committee checks the box ___ to learn about residents' ___ concerns.
grammar.promptZh: 委员会每天检查意见箱，以了解居民日常的关切。
grammar.explanation: 第一空说明检查的频率，使用分开的every day；第二空修饰名词concerns，使用形容词everyday。

reading.title: Counting Voices, Not Just Speeches
reading.titleZh: 不只数发言，也要看谁被听见
reading.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创分级模拟
reading.topic: 居民参与、证据范围与措施局限
reading.passage:
In a fictional neighborhood, a community council invited residents to discuss changes to a small public garden. The meeting lasted two hours, and its record contained thirty comments. The organizing committee first described this as strong evidence that local opinions had been widely collected.

However, a volunteer noticed that six residents had made most of the comments. Several people had left early to collect children, while others had listened without speaking. Counting speeches showed how active the discussion was, but it did not show how many different experiences the council had heard.

For the next stage, the committee placed a simple feedback form in the community center and offered an online version. Residents could describe how they used the garden and suggest one improvement. Paper copies helped people who preferred not to use a website. A box remained available for a week, giving those with different schedules another chance to respond.

The committee also changed its report. It listed the number of individual contributors separately from the number of comments and explained how feedback had been collected. Written responses broadened participation, but they did not guarantee that every group was represented. People who rarely visited the center might still be missing. Rather than claiming to speak for everyone, the committee identified this limit and planned to ask which residents had not yet had a practical chance to contribute.
reading.passageZh:
在一个虚构的街区，社区议事会邀请居民讨论一座小型公共花园的调整。会议持续了两个小时，记录中有三十条意见。组织委员会起初把这描述为已经广泛收集当地意见的有力证据。

然而，一名志愿者注意到，大多数意见都来自六位居民。有些人为了接孩子提前离开，另一些人只是听而没有发言。统计发言次数可以显示讨论有多活跃，却不能说明议事会听到了多少种不同的经历。

在下一阶段，委员会在社区中心放置了一份简单的反馈表，并提供了在线版本。居民可以说明自己怎样使用花园，并提出一项改进建议。纸质表格方便了不愿使用网站的人。意见箱持续开放了一周，让作息不同的人也有机会回应。

委员会还修改了报告，把独立参与者的人数和意见条数分别列出，并解释了收集反馈的方式。书面回应扩大了参与范围，但并不能保证每个群体都有代表。很少到社区中心的人仍可能没有被覆盖。委员会没有声称自己代表所有人，而是指出了这一局限，并计划了解哪些居民还没有真正便利的参与机会。

questions.prompt: Why did the committee initially consider the meeting successful?
questions.promptZh: 委员会最初为什么认为会议取得了成功？
options: Every resident had attended the discussion.
The meeting produced thirty recorded comments.
The garden had already been rebuilt.
All comments supported the same proposal.
optionsZh: 每位居民都参加了讨论。
会议产生了三十条有记录的意见。
所有意见都支持同一项提案。
questions.explanation: 第一段中，委员会把三十条意见当作广泛收集意见的证据。但后文说明发言条数不能直接说明覆盖了多少不同的人。

questions.prompt: What did the volunteer discover about the comments?
questions.promptZh: 志愿者发现这些意见有什么特点？
options: Most were submitted through a website.
They were made by thirty different residents.
Most came from a small number of residents.
optionsZh: 没有一条涉及公共花园。
它们来自三十位不同的居民。
大多数来自少数几位居民。
questions.explanation: 第二段明确指出，六位居民提出了大多数意见。发言频繁与参与者覆盖广是不同的概念。

questions.prompt: How did the feedback arrangements offer another chance to participate?
questions.promptZh: 新的反馈安排怎样提供了更多参与机会？
options: They provided paper and online forms and allowed a week for responses.
They required everyone to speak at another two-hour meeting.
They accepted comments only from previous speakers.
They replaced all written forms with a single website.
optionsZh: 提供纸质和在线表格，并留出一周回应时间。
要求每个人在另一场两小时的会议上发言。
只接受之前发过言的人提出意见。
用一个网站取代了所有纸质表格。
questions.explanation: 第三段的两种表格照顾了不同的使用习惯，一周的开放时间也适应了不同作息。它们扩大机会，但不代表所有人必然参与。

questions.prompt: Which conclusion best reflects the final report?
questions.promptZh: 哪一结论最符合最终报告的态度？
options: Written feedback proves that everyone has been represented.
The number of speeches should be the only measure of participation.
Participation became broader, but some residents might still be missing.
People who do not visit the center have no relevant opinions.
optionsZh: 书面反馈证明所有人都已得到代表。
发言次数应是衡量参与的唯一标准。
参与范围扩大了，但仍可能遗漏部分居民。
不到社区中心的人没有相关意见。
questions.explanation: 末段说明书面回应扩大了参与，却不能保证每个群体都被覆盖；很少到中心的人仍可能缺席。因此报告应承认局限，而不是作出全覆盖的断言。

listening.title: Preparing for a Community Donation Event
listening.tip: 盲听先记活动的目的、时间与地点；带文精听区分可接收与不可接收物品，并核对登记要求。选择三句各做一组影子跟读，再用30—60秒复述参加活动的步骤。安排为虚构教学情境；使用浏览器合成朗读，不是真题录音。
listening.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创模拟 · 浏览器合成朗读
listening.passage: Here is an update about Saturday's donation event at the community center. Please bring clean winter coats, blankets, or unopened notebooks. We cannot accept electrical equipment or food at this event. Donations will be received from ten until noon in the west hall. The main entrance is closed for repairs, so use the garden gate. Before arriving, complete the registration form on the center's website. List the types of items you plan to bring. You do not need to enter their prices. If your plans change, update the form rather than creating another entry. Volunteers will check donations before placing them on the tables. Registration helps us prepare space, but it does not guarantee that everything is accepted.
listening.passageZh: 这里更新一下周六社区中心捐赠活动的信息。请带来干净的冬季外套、毯子或未拆封的笔记本。本次活动不接收电器设备或食品。捐赠物品将于上午十点至中午在西厅接收。正门因维修关闭，因此请使用花园门。到达之前，请在中心网站填写登记表。列出你打算带来的物品种类，不需要填写价格。如果计划有变，请修改表格，而不要新建一条登记。志愿者会先检查捐赠物品，再把它们放到桌子上。登记可以帮助我们准备空间，但并不保证每件物品都能被接收。
dictation: You do not need to enter their prices.
The main entrance is closed for repairs, so use the garden gate.
dictationZh: 不需要填写物品价格。
正门因维修关闭，因此请使用花园门。

questions.prompt: Where and when will donations be received?
questions.promptZh: 活动将在什么时间、地点接收捐赠物品？
options: At the main entrance from noon until two.
In the west hall from ten until noon.
At the garden gate on Friday evening.
In the east hall throughout Saturday.

在西厅，上午十点至中午。

questions.prompt: What should people do before bringing their donations?
questions.promptZh: 人们带来捐赠物品前应该做什么？
options: Attach a price label to every item.
Create a separate entry each time their plans change.
Complete an online form listing the types of items.
optionsZh: 给每件物品贴上价格标签。
每次计划改变都新建一条登记。
认为登记就保证物品被接收。
在线填写表格，列出物品种类。
questions.explanation: 通知要求到达前填写网站登记表，列出物品种类，不需要价格；计划变化时修改原表。登记只帮助准备空间，不代表所有物品都会被接收。

sent.text: The written responses that residents submitted after the meeting helped the committee understand concerns that had not been raised during the discussion.
sent.main: The written responses helped the committee understand concerns.
sent.mainZh: 这些书面回应帮助委员会了解了关切。
sent.translation: 居民在会议之后提交的书面回应，帮助委员会了解了讨论期间没有被提出的关切。
sent.structure: 主干是The written responses helped the committee understand concerns；第一个that引导定语从句，修饰responses；第二个that引导定语从句，修饰concerns。help somebody do something表示帮助某人做某事。
grammar: submitted是第一个定语从句的谓语，helped才是主句谓语；不能因出现submitted就漏掉helped。
that had not been raised during the discussion使用过去完成时的被动形式，说明这些关切在此前的讨论中没有被提出；that指concerns。
sent.examTip: 先圈出responses—helped—committee understand concerns，再补充两处that从句分别修饰的对象，避免把所有谓语混成一层。

2026-10-27.title: 植物与观察：让记录帮助下一位接手的人
2026-10-27.grammarTip: 四级专项衔接：阅读追踪问题—措施—结果，区分已经完成的工作与计划中的工作；听力抓住调整后的顺序和禁止事项。重点巩固主句与定语从句的谓语、形容词前的be、介词后动名词及think/thing。核心阅读与听力为虚构教学情境，不是新闻；泛读另用真实名著原文。

words.example: Apple blossom covered the branches in spring.

grammar.prompt: The student who ___ the notebook is responsible for recording today's work.

reading.title: A Garden Record That Survives Its Gardener
reading.titleZh: 让花园记录不因人员离开而中断
reading.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创分级模拟
reading.topic: 团队交接、记录用途与信息分类
reading.passage:
At an imaginary college, a gardening club changed its volunteer team each term. The plants stayed, but much of the knowledge left with the experienced members. New volunteers could see which beds looked healthy, yet they often did not know what had been planted or when the soil had last been watered.

One departing member offered to write a long account of everything she remembered. Another suggested a simpler approach: record information while the work was taking place, in a form that the next person could quickly use. The club tested a notebook with a map of the garden and a number for each bed. Every entry included a date, the bed number, and a brief description of the action taken.

The volunteers kept completed work separate from future plans. Writing that seeds should be planted on Friday was not the same as confirming that someone had planted them. They also recorded observations without turning them immediately into instructions. A yellow leaf, for example, was something to investigate rather than an automatic request for more water.

At the next change of team, the notebook gave newcomers a starting point for asking questions. It did not replace practical experience or advice from a skilled gardener. Its value was more modest: people no longer had to rebuild the basic history of every bed before deciding what to do next.
reading.passageZh:
在一所虚构的大学里，园艺社团每学期都会更换志愿者团队。植物留了下来，但许多经验却随着有经验的成员离开而流失。新志愿者能看出哪些种植畦长势良好，却常常不知道里面种了什么，也不知道土壤上次是什么时候浇的水。

一名即将离开的成员提出，把自己记得的事情写成长篇记录。另一人建议采用更简单的方式：工作进行时就记录信息，并使用下一位接手者能快速利用的格式。社团试用了一本笔记本，里面附有花园地图，每块种植畦都有编号。每条记录包括日期、畦的编号，以及已采取行动的简短说明。

志愿者把已完成的工作与未来计划分开记录。写下周五应当播种，并不等于确认有人已经播种。他们也记录观察结果，而不立即把它们变成操作指令。例如，一片黄叶是需要调查的现象，而不是自动意味着应该多浇水。

下一次团队交接时，笔记本为新成员提问提供了起点。它并没有取代实践经验或熟练园丁的建议。它的价值更为有限而实在：人们不再需要先重建每块种植畦的基本历史，才能决定下一步做什么。

questions.prompt: What problem occurred when experienced members left?
questions.promptZh: 有经验的成员离开时出现了什么问题？
options: All the plants were moved to a different garden.
New volunteers lost access to useful information about earlier work.
The college stopped allowing students to grow plants.
Every bed had to be watered at exactly the same time.
optionsZh: 所有植物被移到了另一个花园。
新志愿者缺少有关此前工作的有用信息。
学校不再允许学生种植植物。
每块种植畦都必须在完全相同的时间浇水。
questions.explanation: 首段说明植物仍在，但经验随成员离开而流失；新成员不清楚种植内容和最近的浇水时间。

questions.prompt: Why did the club include bed numbers in its notebook?
questions.promptZh: 社团为什么在笔记本中记录种植畦编号？
options: To rank volunteers by the amount of work they did.

listening.passage: This message is for students helping in the greenhouse tomorrow. Please arrive at nine and collect the notebook from the gardener. After checking the plants, record what you actually did in the notebook. Put suggestions for the next team on a separate page. The gardener will review those suggestions before anyone acts on them.

reading.title: When the Numbers Do Not Match
reading.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创分级模拟
reading.topic: 实验记录、证据与结论边界
reading.passage:
In an imaginary science workshop, students used a simple device to measure how far a small cart travelled down a slope. Before starting, each group wrote a prediction. The teacher asked them to keep this prediction beside the measurements, even if the numbers later disagreed.

One group obtained a much shorter distance than expected. A member wanted to remove the result because it made the table look untidy. Another argued that an unexpected number was still part of their observation. They recorded it and checked whether the cart had started from the same position.

They discovered that a loose strip of paper had touched one wheel. After removing it, they repeated the measurement. The later distances were closer together, but the group kept the earlier result and added a note explaining the change in conditions. A reader could now understand both what happened and why the procedure changed.

The teacher did not ask the class to claim that every unusual result had the same cause. A different group might need to check the surface, the device, or the way a distance was read. Repeating an experiment without considering these possibilities would not automatically make a conclusion reliable.

For their final report, students had to separate what they predicted, what they observed, and what they could reasonably conclude. A neat table mattered less than a clear account of the evidence.
reading.passageZh:
在一次虚构的科学工作坊中，学生用简单装置测量小车沿斜坡滑行的距离。开始前，每组写下预测。老师要求他们把预测保留在测量结果旁边，即使后来的数字不一致也要如此。

一组测出的距离比预期短很多。一名成员想删除这个结果，因为它让表格显得不整齐。另一人认为，意外数字仍是观察结果的一部分。他们记录下来，并检查小车是否从相同位置出发。

他们发现一条松动的纸碰到了一只车轮。移走纸条后，他们再次测量。后来的距离更接近，但小组保留了先前的结果，并加注说明条件发生了什么变化。这样，读者既能理解发生了什么，也能理解为什么改变步骤。

老师没有要求全班声称每个异常结果都有同样的原因。其他小组可能需要检查表面、装置或距离读数的方法。如果不考虑这些可能性，重复实验并不会自动让结论可靠。

最终报告要求学生区分预测、观察结果和可以合理得出的结论。整齐的表格不如对证据的清楚说明重要。

questions.prompt: Why did one student want to remove the first result?
questions.promptZh: 为什么一名学生想删掉最初的结果？

questions.prompt: What did the group do after finding the paper?
questions.promptZh: 发现纸条后，小组做了什么？

Discarded every result without an explanation.
Changed its prediction to match the first number.
optionsZh: 移走纸条、重测并记录变化。
不作解释地丢弃所有结果。
修改预测，使其符合第一个数字。
questions.explanation: 第三段包含移除、重测、保留旧结果和附注四个连续动作。

options: Assuming that repetition alone guarantees reliability.

listening.title: A Laboratory Tour with Questions
listening.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创模拟 · 浏览器合成朗读
listening.tip: 先盲听抓目的与顺序，再带文精听核对时间和转折；完成全文分段听写，选三句做三组影子跟读，最后脱稿复述30—60秒。合成朗读可调速、暂停、继续、停止，不是真题录音。
listening.passage: Welcome to the student laboratory tour on Wednesday afternoon. The visit starts at two, but please arrive ten minutes early. Leave your bags in the lockers outside the main entrance. We will first watch a demonstration of a microscope. You may draw what you see, but do not move the specimens. After that, a guide will explain the records beside each instrument. One column shows a prediction, while another shows the actual measurement. If the numbers differ, ask how the team checks possible causes. Do not erase a result simply because it seems surprising. The final discussion takes place in the classroom across the corridor. Please bring your questions there rather than testing any equipment yourself.

reading.title: Which Notice Should You Follow?
reading.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创周复盘模拟
reading.topic: 信息更新、范围限定与依据定位
reading.passage:
In a fictional college, the history society announced an evening talk in Room 204. Its first notice gave the starting time, the room number, and a request to bring a notebook. Two days later, the organizers discovered that the room would be used for another event. They moved the talk to Room 306 and posted an updated notice.

Several students saw only a photograph of the first notice in a group conversation. Others saw the second notice but assumed that every detail had changed. One student arrived an hour early, although the starting time was exactly the same on both notices.

The organizers responded by placing the two versions side by side. They marked the changed room number and added a short sentence confirming that the time and the request about notebooks remained unchanged. They also put the date of the update near the title, where readers could find it quickly.

During a later reading workshop, students used these notices to discuss a common mistake: treating new information as a complete replacement for everything read before. Sometimes a new message changes only one condition. Readers need to identify that condition rather than invent additional changes.

The workshop leader asked each student to support an answer with a line from the notices. This made it easier to distinguish a reasoned decision from a lucky guess, even when both produced the same answer.
reading.passageZh:
在一所虚构大学，历史社团通知大家到204室参加晚间讲座。第一则通知列出了开始时间、房间号，并要求带笔记本。两天后，组织者发现房间将用于另一场活动，于是把讲座移至306室，张贴了更新通知。

一些学生只在群聊里看到第一则通知的照片。另一些学生看到了第二则，却以为每个细节都变了。一名学生提前一小时到达，虽然两则通知上的开始时间完全相同。

组织者把两个版本并排展示，标记改变后的房间号，又加了一句简短说明，确认时间和带笔记本的要求保持不变。他们还将更新日期放在标题附近，让读者能迅速找到。

后来一次阅读工作坊使用这两则通知，讨论一种常见错误：把新信息当作对先前一切信息的完全替换。有时新消息只改变一个条件，读者需要识别这个条件，而不要想象额外的变化。

主持者要求每名学生用通知中的一句话支持自己的答案。这使大家更容易区分有依据的判断与碰巧猜对，即使两者给出了相同答案。

questions.prompt: Why was the talk moved?
questions.promptZh: 为什么讲座换了房间？
options: Room 204 was needed for another event.
Room 306 was closer to every student.
questions.explanation: 首段明确说明原房间将用于另一场活动，所以更换地点；没有取消讲座。

questions.prompt: Which information stayed the same?
questions.promptZh: 哪些信息保持不变？
options: The starting time and the request to bring a notebook.
optionsZh: 开始时间和带笔记本的要求。
questions.explanation: 第三段确认time和request about notebooks未变。

questions.prompt: What reading mistake is discussed?
questions.promptZh: 文章讨论了哪种阅读错误？
options: Assuming that a new notice changes every previous detail.
Looking for the date near a title.
Finding a line to support an answer.
optionsZh: 以为新通知会改变先前所有细节。
questions.explanation: 第四段用complete replacement概括该错误；其他选项是有帮助的做法。

questions.prompt: Why must students provide evidence for their answers?
questions.promptZh: 为什么要求学生提供答题依据？
options: To distinguish reasoning from a lucky guess.
optionsZh: 区分有依据的判断与碰巧猜对。
questions.explanation: 末段说明，即使答案相同，也要区分reasoned decision和lucky guess。

listening.title: Comparing Two Versions
listening.level: 四级专项衔接 · 原创模拟 · 浏览器合成朗读
listening.tip: 先盲听抓目的与顺序，再带文精听核对时间和转折；完成全文分段听写，选三句做三组影子跟读，最后脱稿复述30—60秒。合成朗读可调速、暂停、继续、停止，不是真题录音。
listening.passage: Here are the instructions for Thursday's weekly reading review. You will receive two short notices about the same evening event. The second notice was issued after the organizers changed the room. Read both notices before answering the four questions on your sheet. Underline the details that remain correct and circle the ones that changed. You have eight minutes for this first part of the review. Then compare your reasons with a partner for five minutes. Keep your first answers visible when you add corrections in another color. A correct guess is not enough if you cannot locate the evidence. At the end, write one checking step to use next week.
listening.passageZh: 以下是周四每周阅读复盘的说明。你会收到两则关于同一晚间活动的简短通知。第二则通知是在组织者更换房间后发布的。回答答题纸上的四道题之前，先阅读两则通知。给仍然正确的细节画下划线，圈出发生改变的细节。复盘的第一部分限时八分钟。然后用五分钟和搭档比较作答理由。用另一种颜色补充订正时，保留第一次答案，让它们仍可见。如果找不到依据，仅仅猜对答案还不够。最后，写下一条准备在下周使用的检查步骤。
dictation: Here are the instructions for Thursday's weekly reading review.
You will receive two short notices about the same evening event.
dictationZh: 以下是周四每周阅读复盘的说明。
你会收到两则关于同一晚间活动的简短通知。

questions.prompt: How long is the first part of the review?
questions.promptZh: 复盘的第一部分有多长时间？
questions.explanation: 先独立阅读作答八分钟，之后搭档讨论五分钟；不要混淆阶段。

questions.prompt: What should students do when making corrections?
questions.promptZh: 订正时学生应该怎么做？
options: Keep the first answers visible and use another color.
Copy a partner without discussing reasons.
Replace the notices with a new story.
optionsZh: 保留第一次答案，使用另一种颜色。
不讨论理由，直接抄搭档。
questions.explanation: 通知明确Keep your first answers visible，并要求用另一种颜色补充订正。

sent.text: Students who assumed that every detail had changed overlooked the sentence which confirmed that the starting time was unchanged.
sent.main: Students overlooked the sentence.
sent.mainZh: 学生忽略了那句话。
sent.translation: 那些以为所有细节都变了的学生，忽略了确认开始时间不变的那句话。
sent.structure: 主句Students overlooked the sentence；who assumed...修饰students；which confirmed...修饰sentence；两个that引导的宾语从句分别跟在assumed与confirmed后。
grammar: 主句谓语是overlooked，不是assumed或confirmed。
was unchanged中unchanged作表语，be动词was不能省略。
sent.examTip: 先括起两个定语从句，读出“学生忽略了句子”，再逐层补充内容。
sent.topic: 多层从句与主干提取

trans.answer: If we check the evidence every day, we can gradually improve our reading accuracy.
